title: Catalog format migration and Python script update
description:
Migrate catalog format and update the Python update script from docs/plans/01-ai-core.add03.md.

Sections: 3.8, 6.1-6.3, 4.2-4.4

Key deliverables:
- New catalog.json format: {lastUpdated, providers: {configs}, models: {provider → modelID → model}} — §3.8, §6.2
- catalogFile Go struct with LastUpdated, Providers, Models — §3.8
- Single init() in models.go: register provider configs first, then chat models (deriving API from provider), then embedding models — §3.8
- loadEmbeddingCatalog() with embeddingCatalogFile envelope struct — §6.3
- Remove old init() from embedding_models.go — §3.8
- New embedding_catalog.json format: {lastUpdated, models: [...]} — §6.3
- Add Cohere provider config (embedding-only) — §6.2
- Update scripts/update-model-catalog.py to emit new format:
  - Emit provider configs under "providers" key (apiClientType, baseUrl, keyEnvVars, headers, providerSpecific)
  - Emit model data under "models" key
  - Remove api/baseUrl from per-model entries
  - Remove baseUrl from embedding entries
  - Update validate_catalog() for new structure
  - Maintain lastUpdated + --force freshness mechanism
- TestCatalogNewFormat — §5.2
- Caller migration: demo CLIs, public re-export layer (ai/ai.go) — §4.2-4.4, §7.1
- Property tests: resolution determinism, registry isolation, deep copy integrity — §5.3

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/01-ai-core.add03.md §3.8, §4.2-4.4, §5.2-5.3, §6.1-6.3, §7.1
- Depends on: Stream/Embed entry points task (new resolution path must be in place before catalog switches)
